scope: Conditional loot generation only; no combat, survival or playtime claims. Collection packing has complete hindsight (density or collection priority), not default autopick; 30-cell bitmask cross-checked against core.

distributionCheck.bound: 5*sqrt(n*p*(1-p))+5 count tolerance; diagnostic not formal goodness-of-fit p-value

unconditionalBattleGoodLoot.definition: failure or extracted without any carried rarity >=3; not no-gold/no-red; includes initial equipment if retained
unconditionalBattleGoodLoot.independenceCaveat: three-consecutive low outcomes is plug-in p^3, not observed streak frequency; Wilson interval transformed assuming IID fixed policy; adaptive route/team play invalidates IID

smartProtectedBattleGoodLoot.method: Actual core smart loot confirmation, protecting existing equipment and consumables; paired run seeds. p^3 is independent fixed-policy estimate, not observed streak.
